dedupe_keys.name: cal fire damage inspection dins database

description: The CAL FIRE Damage Inspection database records structures affected by wildland fire in California's State Responsibility Area, inside or within 300 feet of each fire perimeter. Inspectors record structure type, construction features and defensive actions as best they can, and give a damage rating from 0 to 10% affected through to destroyed; null attributes could not be determined. Qualifying structures are at least 120 square feet with two or more outside walls. Two address sets are held: field-determined street information and a parcel address and APN added by spatial join after collection. The publisher warns that fire damage and poor access limit inspectors, so not every structure may be found and a small margin of error is expected. Publisher: CAL FIRE. Coverage: California, incident by incident, updated irregularly; the open data portal showed it modified on 29 September 2026. Access: free download as CSV, Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML, geodatabase, Excel or GeoPackage, and through an ArcGIS REST service. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution; cost free. Useful for wildfire vulnerability curves, exposure and loss models, and code effectiveness studies. It relates to the Dryad wildfire building damage risk index record in the catalogue, which is derived from DINS records.
